text: At its meeting held April 7 and 8, City Council appointed the following members to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee for a term of office from April 9, 2021 to November 14, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Luke Anderson Ashleigh Molloy Lana Williams These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Karima Ewig and Michael Miceli who resigned in November 2020, and Stefanie Marinich-Lee who resigned in February 2021.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
